name: University of Luxembourg
summary: Multilingual university at Esch-Belval and in Luxembourg City; two bachelor's run mainly in English: Computer Science and Music Education.

ib.text: Your IB needs an equivalence from Luxembourg's Ministry of Education; you request it and it takes weeks. You may apply before results. An English-taught IB proves English. No points minimum is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Computer Science
programmes.ib: English B2 required. A small part of the course uses French or German (B1 recommended, no certificate). 90 places, selected on maths, science and overall grades and a cover letter.

programmes.name: Bachelor en Enseignement musical (Bachelor in Music Education)
programmes.ib: English C1. You need an advanced music diploma for your specialisation, or you sit an audition, a written solfège test and an interview in July.

notes: Most other bachelor's are bilingual or trilingual and require French or German, e.g. Business Administration asks for B2 in both French and English.
Each application costs a non-refundable €100, which is deducted from your first semester's fees if you enrol.
Uni.lu says its criteria for 2027-2028 are under review; for 2026 entry, EU applicants to Computer Science could apply from 1 February to 15 July.
